input.title: Unisex Golf – Sorry About Your Windshield Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny golf zip up hoodie is for the golfer whose slice has a reputation in the parking lot, zipped on for the range and the walk back to the car, hoping it is not yours.

A golfer in a flat cap and argyle sweater finishes his swing as a ball arcs away toward a row of vintage cars, one with a starred crack in its windshield, in navy, orange, sage and cream with a worn print texture. SORRY ABOUT runs above it and YOUR WINDSHIELD below in tall condensed capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: cream and orange on Black and Navy, navy and rust on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small golf ball on a tee is embroidered on the left chest, and the word SORRY is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest golf ball and tee and left-cuff SORRY, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Sorry About Your Windshield zip hoodie fit?
The Sorry About Your Windshield funny golf zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this funny golf hoodie warm enough for cold range mornings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold range mornings, windy fairways and the walk back to the car well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, SORRY ABOUT above the art and YOUR WINDSHIELD below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small golf ball on a tee sits on the left chest with no words, and SORRY is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The golf ball and tee on the chest and the SORRY cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a golfer, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the player with a famous slice and a good sense of humor. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
